surfaces.part: dusty packed earth ground field, uniform noise texture across the full 96x80 area

answer.evidence: This is a seamless terrain tile field, not a standing object. The silhouette is a full 96-wide rectangle across all rows 0-79 with no outline, no front-edge line, no eave shadow, and no front face or side face. The column scans show only mottled earth tones with scattered dark crack pixels and light pebble pixels, with no band that reads as a top surface ending in an edge. It is a flat ground texture, so the standing-object top-surface and front-face rules do not apply. I use 'other' because terrain is not a standing object.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a ground field, the same kind as the grass and paving references. It shows 6 visible tones per tile, above the grass reference (3) and close to the paving reference (7). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no flat 5x5 fills. The surface is mottled throughout with tonal patches and fine speckle grain, and it reads as packed earth rather than a flat fill. Ground has no object outline, and the 0% neutral dark-edge share confirms nothing reads as a black sticker line. The darker tones are tinted brown. The weakness is that the speckle is fairly even and noise-like, and the long cracks and pebbles are only faintly legible. That is a structure shortfall, not a shading-depth failure. Overall it holds up beside the references.
